name: when-building-is-free
description: Product management skills for AI software factories, from the When Building Is Free series.

plugins.name: feature-charter
plugins.description: Enrich existing specs with an outcome charter: one result metric, guardrails, an expiry date and a removal plan. Validator and CI gate included.

plugins.name: feedback-triage
plugins.description: Triage feedback and issues against a written product strategy: areas, duplicates by account, past rulings, failure-mode flags and a shortlist ranked by where users fail. Writes the strategy file and a bet board for leaders.
